review_scope: Concept-authority (semantic) alignment of Ground Control's native concept families against the ACES concept families published in the aces-sdl==0.23.0 distribution (per ADR-084 §4). The effect is directional and states the external ACES family's effect on Ground Control's native meaning under the closed effect vocabulary annotates|aligns|refines|constrains: `refines` means the ACES family is narrower than the named Ground Control family, with the narrowing recorded in `divergences`. All seven Ground Control families are `native` and none is adopted from ACES, so no correspondence is recorded as `aligns` (equivalent meaning with an empty divergence list). The reviewed ACES catalog bytes are retained verbatim at the pinned `reference_snapshot`; the ontology crosswalk policy gate recomputes their SHA-256 and resolves every family reference in-process with no upstream lookup. Time is deliberately omitted from v1 (see `omissions`).

alignments.rationale: Both families cover recorded observations; ACES `observables` is the narrower conditions/metrics/telemetry slice.
divergences: ACES `observables` scopes to conditions, metrics, and observable properties; Ground Control `evidence-and-observation` also spans durable evidence artifacts, source provenance, and supersession chains that ACES routes to `provenance-and-evidence` instead.
Ground Control preserves the distinct OBSERVED_ON / OBSERVED_IN endpoint roles inside this family; ACES `observables` does not carry those relation semantics.

alignments.rationale: The evidence-record half of Ground Control's `evidence-and-observation` corresponds to ACES `provenance-and-evidence`, which is the narrower experiment-scoped evidence family.
divergences: ACES `provenance-and-evidence` scopes to run provenance records, evidence expectations, and audit artifacts for experiments and execution; Ground Control `evidence-and-observation` is assurance-wide and also carries observations, which ACES routes to `observables`.
ACES separates provenance from observation across two families; Ground Control folds durable evidence and observation into one native family.

alignments.rationale: Both families express provenance lineage; ACES `provenance-and-evidence` is the narrower experiment-execution-scoped provenance family.
divergences: Ground Control `research-and-provenance` scopes to research-workflow lineage connecting sources, intermediate artifacts, claims, and prose (ADR-069); ACES `provenance-and-evidence` scopes to experiment run provenance, evidence expectations, and audit records.
Ground Control keeps CITATION, derivation, selection, and contribution as distinct provenance meanings; ACES does not enumerate those research-specific relations.

alignments.rationale: Both families organize execution lifecycle; ACES `tasks-runs-studies` is the narrower experiment task/run/study organization family (the tasks-runs-studies <-> workflow-runs pairing in ADR-084 §4).
divergences: ACES `tasks-runs-studies` scopes to experiment task framing, run lifecycle, and study grouping; Ground Control `workflow-and-process` spans engineering-process and lifecycle concepts broadly and does not carry experiment-study semantics.

Ground Control `workflow-and-process` explicitly excludes evidence, requirement status, and research provenance from workflow state; ACES `tasks-runs-studies` references `provenance-and-evidence` as recorded run outputs.

alignments.rationale: Ground Control folds operational assets into `architecture-and-boundaries`; ACES `assets` is the narrower node/infrastructure slice.
divergences: ACES `assets` covers nodes, infrastructure, networks, and deployable resources (UCO-adopted); Ground Control `architecture-and-boundaries` additionally covers documents, structural containment, communication, trust, and access boundaries.
Ground Control keeps containment, access, communication, dependency, and data flow as distinct boundary relation meanings; ACES `assets` does not own those relation semantics.

omissions.reason: Ground Control has no time concept family against which ACES `time-and-apparatus` can be aligned. ADR-084 §5 makes the Envers revision number the canonical as-of spine — a decided temporal semantic deliberately not expressed as a concept family. A crosswalk row for time therefore requires a Ground Control time family to exist first, which is an ADR-084 question and an ADR amendment, not a crosswalk-v1 change.
